chunks: From him, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sa'id ibn Yasar, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a woman who menstruates, then becomes pure, and then perhaps sees after that a slight amount of thin blood after her ghusl from her purity. He said: She should practice istizhar after her days by one day, or two days, or three, then she performs salat (prayer).

key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرُ: she exercises precaution by extending the waiting period

ai.seo_question: What should a woman do if she sees light blood after becoming pure from menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman who sees slight thin blood after becoming pure from menstruation and performing ghusl. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that she should observe precaution by extending beyond her usual days by one, two, or three days, and then perform salat (prayer).
